english: Hey, Viper. Said you poured love into building Gettaway, right?
Shouldn't you have given your son even a little of that love?
YOU'RE the delinquent. Shape up and be a father again.
Sougo. Left my protractor at home. Gonna pop back for it.
Oh! I remember! Those bombs were...!
Our men did well. Recovered every one!
Don't tell me he got caught?!
That giant firework doll? Smashed it already.
You knew about that too, Hijikata?
You the one who wants to talk to us?
Of course. We think there's something fishy about Gin Tama too.
Wait, bastard! Tell us everything you know!
Fine. If I win a Gin Tama battle, you tell me everything.
Space pirates Banbanji made Gin Tama?!
Odd, though. A secret weapon? They're just toys.
That's one hell of a story.
So that's why you came to us?
Kabukicho's in danger! No, Edo! No, EARTH!
What do you want us to DO?!
I'll explain to the men.\fThis time, volunteers only.
Talk or I'll finish you here!
Insult someone in Japanese when they don't understand it? Doesn't work.\fSame thing?
Not smaller. Gin Tama will destroy Earth.
I see. Your code stops you acting.\fNo point talking, then.
Don't! Swords and bazookas are old news.\fIt's the age of Gin Tama now.
Stop! I didn't come for a fight!
Hear my story and you can't just sit there.
They've developed a terrifying secret weapon.
The original Gin Tama, to be exact.
Someone modified them for Earth's culture. No, EDO'S culture.
Only someone who knows Edo's culture well could do that.
Don't know exactly what happened.\fBut leave Gin Tama alone and disaster's certain.
Told you that at the start.
Well? Still can't go against your code?
That's all. Up to the Shinsengumi now.
Told Kintoki and Katsura too. But this is too dangerous.\fThey're my friends. Don't want to drag them further into it.
Who else can I count on?
You're police.\fPolice with samurai souls? Won't find that anywhere else.
The Amanto pressuring the shogunate must be Banbanji too.
We know you're with the space pirates.
Can't admit it, given your position?
Hire a more loyal dog next time.
Frog bastard... I mean, Lord Kinya. How about a deal?
Tell us what you know and we'll keep quiet about you.
Who cares if he's an alien?! Fire, Sougo!
Mere apes! Think you can get away with this?!
What?! Don't be ridiculous!\fThose Harusame suspicions were cleared long ago!
What are you talking about...? I don't know...
Lay a finger on me and you'll pay! Still want to try?!
Get them! Kill them if you must!
W-wait! I really don't know anything!
Fine... I'll talk! Everything I know...
Yes, I helped the Banbanji pressure the shogunate...
No idea! I really don't know!
Don't know! I've only met one of them.
Ahh... It's over... If this gets out, the Banbanji will kill me.
Can't kill anyone here!\fWe'll shut them up with Gin Tama first!
Serves you right! Know your place, ape!
A frog with a dog bodyguard. What a surprise.
Sounds like a fair deal to me.
So that's why you helped them?
So... Daraku betrayed Harusame and joined the Banbanji?
Either way, catch Daraku and we'll find out.
His recent movements bother me.\fFeels like he knows something about Gin Tama and Banbanji.
Just looking for a bit. Tell Kondo that.
Hijikata. Maybe Daraku's connected to the Banbanji.
Daraku and Gin Tama seem connected.\fBut Gin Tama are the Banbanji's secret weapon.
The Banbanji might fight Harusame, but those upstarts wouldn't join them.
...And that was the last we saw of Hijikata...
Well... Daraku apparently helped with the jailbreak...
Commander told us. We ALL volunteered!
Haha... Thought you'd say that, Vice-Chief.
Gotta catch him and make him talk...
Hm? Down by the river... That idiot and...
Found you! Not escaping this time!
Don't give me that lazy reply! What happened?
Quit the nonsense! Pull yourself together!
